# Buildings (generated)

Source: `BUILDING_TYPES` and `JOBS_PER_LEVEL` in `src/game/buildings.mjs`, `RECIPES` in `src/sim/recipes.mjs`. Type of data: game design values (assumed). Costs are per level: materials, fee and build time all multiply by the level you build or upgrade to. Materials come first from your warehouse in the city; what the port lacks is imported at IMPORT_MUL = 1.5 over base price plus fee (`src/sim/recipes.mjs`). Upkeep and wages (1 coin per worker per day, `WAGE_PER_WORKER`) accrue daily into the weekly book; a building that cannot be paid halts. † marks a civic building of the city-life module (respect gates and per-city caps, see [buildings.md](../buildings.md)); ‡ needs a minimum city population.
